min_stay.season: Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends

values.note: ReserveAmerica: 'Campsites are reservable April 1-Oct 31. Certain sites may be open through Dec. 31 of the current year. Reservations for the following year will open in mid-December.' 2026 holiday minimums: Memorial Day weekend 4 nights, July 4th weekend 3 nights, Labor Day weekend 4 nights (each Thursday or Friday start). Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground; a one-time 14-day extension needs the park manager's written permission, and a five-day absence is required before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/camping/prairie-dog-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=KS&parkId=519130 (Booking Rules; 'Holiday Reservation Minimum Requirements'; '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule'; Key Info), read 2026-10-20

values.note: ReserveAmerica types 10 sites Standard Full Hookup (Cedar Ridge 201-210: 50/30/20 amp, water and sewer), 79 water and electric and 2 electric-only. Branded Cedar water/electric sites are mostly 30/20 amp. The park's own key info still says 'There are no sewer sites at Prairie Dog State Park.' Seasonal water system, usually off mid-October to mid-April.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list and site details for parkId 519130 (2026-10-20: Cedar Ridge Campground sites 201-210 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30/20', 'Water Hookup: Y', 'Sewer Hookup: Y')

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 238 campsites: 147 primitive, 79 water and electric, 10 full hookup and 2 electric-only, across Prairie Dog, Shady Rest, Cedar Ridge, Branded Cedar, Cottonwood and Meadowlark areas (plus 4 cabins). The park's description says 69 electric/water, 12 electric-only and more than 130 primitive sites. Cedar Ridge and Branded Cedar sites sampled are pull-through, listed to 80 ft.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica park page for parkId 519130 ('242 site(s) found': Primitive Site 147, Standard Full Hookup 10, Standard with Electric Hookup 2, Standard with Water and Electric Hookups 79, plus cabins; site details for the first 25 listed sites), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/camping/prairie-dog-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=KS&parkId=519130 ('Shower and restroom facilities are conveniently located, as are two RV dump stations'; amenities 'Toilet, Pit/Vault', 'Water Drinking'; 'seasonal water system which is usually shut off in mid-October and turned back on in mid-April'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: ReserveAmerica: campsites reservable April 1 - October 31, certain sites open through December 31; facility status 'Open year round'. Water is shut off from about mid-October to mid-April.

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica, 14-night max (now on the entry), water + sewer (10 full-hookup sites in the catalog). Added 50-amp, 238 sites, 80 ft, pull-throughs, 2026 holiday minimums (4/3/4 nights), showers, two dump stations, vault toilets, seasonal water. Fees left as recorded (Nov 1, 2026 statewide schedule, AWH 2026-10-15); RA's fee table still shows the current rates. Season dates not written: RA says reservable Apr 1-Oct 31 with some sites through Dec 31, but status 'Open year round'. ksoutdoors.gov blocks automated reads (Akamai 403).
flags: Sewer conflict between official pages: the park's own Key Info on ReserveAmerica says 'There are no sewer sites at Prairie Dog State Park', while the same booking site sells 10 'Standard Full Hookup' sites (Cedar Ridge 201-210, Sewer Hookup: Y). Recorded sewer: true from the site catalog.
